caption: Lightning flashes inside a bank of dark clouds over a city, and the clouds glow for a moment and then go dark.

sa.check: A city skyline under a dark sky.
A bank of dark clouds above it.
A flash lights the clouds from within.
The glow is inside or among the clouds, not a bolt to the ground.
The city lights stay as they were.

pc.expect: The glow is brief: the clouds light up and then return to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The clouds stay lit for the rest of the clip; or the glow brightens steadily without ending; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The glow comes from within or behind the clouds: their undersides and edges brighten with their texture revealed.
pc.fail: The flash lights the city streets while the clouds stay dark; or the glow is a flat wash over the whole frame with no cloud structure.

pc.expect: The cloud bank and skyline are unchanged by the flash: the same clouds and the same buildings, revealed and then hidden.
pc.fail: Buildings appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the cloud shapes differ between the lit frame and the dark ones; or the skyline moves.

pc.expect: City lights stay steady through the flash; clouds drift only slowly.
pc.fail: City lights blink out at the flash or all change at once; or the clouds jump or swirl at the flash; or the buildings sway.

pc.expect: The skyline and clouds keep their shape; nothing passes through a building.
pc.fail: A building changes shape; or the clouds turn into solid objects; or lightning passes through a building and lights its interior like a lamp; or the city duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The colour of the night sky and the city lights is consistent before and after.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour permanently after the flash; or windows change lit pattern all at once; or the clouds change colour when not lit.
